skill: Identify which single elementary row operation maps one displayed 3×3 matrix to another; select the unique correct operation from a five-choice radio bank.
reasoning_steps: Compare all rows to locate changed row(s).
For a swap, identify the exchanged rows; for one changed row, distinguish scaling from adding a multiple of another row.
Infer or test the nonzero multiplier and verify all entries, then select the valid bank operation.
response_contract: Observed question banks use one selection radio field with five math choices. Canonical example has a worked operation but no answer field. No free-entry requirement inferred.
difficulty: Moderate: one elementary operation, small integer matrices, integer or simple rational scalar; no solving a system or multi-step elimination.
invariants: One elementary operation; scaling multiplier nonzero; row addition uses distinct source and destination.
Displayed target, unique valid offered choice, and worked calculation agree.
Preserve complete source banks including plausible incorrect/non-elementary distractors.
Three by three ordinary matrices and five-option radio questions are the observed assessed format.
permitted_variations: Eligible destination/source indices and swapped pairs may vary across all three rows.
Operation type, scalar sign and simple magnitude, matrix entries and zero locations may vary while preserving one-step workload.
Labels, choice order, and distractor profiles may vary; matrix names must not determine the operation.
A fixed source-example correct type or row assignment is incidental; source and target matrices must determine it.

answer_roles.eligible: all ordered distinct pairs, or any scale destination
positive/negative integers and simple rationals as supported
